definitions.explanation: An accommodation option where only the room is provided, with no meals included.

examples.japanese: {素泊|すど}まり⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{素泊|すど}まり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since I'll eat out, I chose room-only lodging.

examples.japanese: {素泊|すど}まり⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧5000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧。
examples.english: Room-only rate is 5000 yen per night.

notes:
FORMATION:
{素|す} (plain, bare — a prefix meaning "nothing added") + ⟦{泊|と}まり→泊まり：22935_tomari⟧ (an overnight stay)

ACCOMMODATION OPTIONS:
・{素泊|すど}まり - room only (no meals)
・⟦{朝食付|ちょうしょくつ}き→朝食付き：07826_choushokutsuki⟧ - with breakfast
・⟦{夕食付|ゆうしょくつ}き→夕食付き：noentry⟧ - with dinner
・⟦{一泊二食付|いっぱくにしょくつ}き→一泊二食付き：noentry⟧ - one night with two meals (dinner and breakfast)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{素泊|すど}まり⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧ - room-only plan
・{素泊|すど}まり⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ - room-only rate
・{素泊|すど}まり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧ - to stay on a room-only basis

USAGE NOTE:
This word comes up when booking a ryokan (a Japanese inn) or a minshuku (a family-run guesthouse), where meals are traditionally included in the standard rate, so the room-only option has to be named explicitly.
